body:
if i understood the feature correctly:
go to project>export> chose the target platform  (in your case android) , runing OS.has_feature, with any of the default values features will aways return true, if you run it with "debug" will also retur true if you run the code from the editor (as a pluging or clicking on the run button on the editor), but any custom feature will not be detected on the editor.
custom features only seem to work when the project is really exported and running on the target device, this is a nuisance because it create a codepath that only can be tested on the final device without proper debuging.

i recomend trying something else, like creating an file on user:// and identifying if the file do exist or not, to simulate the OS.has_feature thing,  then once the code ready to be shipped for the final clients, you replace it with OS.has_feature if you dont want spare debug files on the user machine.

im not sure if that is a bug or the expected behavior for this api.
